sources.transfers: Alchemy alchemy_getAssetTransfers (erc721, full history, incrementally cached)

componentScaling.rule: Every component is divided by its own upper bound so it enters the sum on [0,1] BEFORE weighting. SPEC §12 #8, decided (Toni) 2026-08-02, option (a).
componentScaling.why: Without it the published weights are false: Muscle lives in [0,C] and Accumulation in [0,cap], so a nominal 10% on Muscle was measured taking 23.7% of raw. Each divisor is the component's own bound — this rescales, it does not reweight.

referee.normaliser: Territory(f) = 100 x raw(f) / max_g raw(g)  — divide by the leader (SPEC §5.1)

muscleCap.why: Influence caps at Soldier — the 5–9 tier ceiling.

washWindowDays.why: N >= season length, so no round-trip completed inside a season can score.

accumulationCap.why: The Soldier tier floor. A cap of 9 would never bind at this volume.

avgHoldtimeWeight.why: avg_holdtime_weight() was UNDEFINED in SPEC §5.1. Defined as the share of the collection's own lifetime this family's tokens have sat still. Bounded to [0,1] and has no free parameter to tune. The alternative min(mean/365,1) saturates to 1.000 for all seven families here, which would make 40% of Territory silently inert — each family's value under it is published as holdtimeWeightIfSaturatingAt365d.

membership.narrative: plurality of holdings, ties to the smaller family (SPEC §5.0 A) — roster and story only
membership.scoring: actual holdings: a wallet counts toward every family it holds, weighted by tokens IN that family (SPEC §5.0 B)

glossary.forHire: tokens the wallet currently has listed — a soldier shopping himself around, not yet a betrayal
glossary.walked: listings ADDED since the last snapshot
glossary.backInTheFold: listings PULLED since the last snapshot
glossary.theWarChest: funded WETH standing behind this wallet's offers — min(total offered, WETH balance)
glossary.timeServed: days since the wallet's first acquisition

warChest.note: Seaport does not escrow — totalFunded is the real bid depth. Count is deliberately NOT the metric; measured 2026-08-02, 3 serious offers (0.093 Ξ) beat 99 dust offers (0.059 Ξ).

sensitivity.note: Per-component min/max across the 7 families. A component whose max equals its min moved nothing this week.

notoriety.note: Status terms are always on; delta terms fall to 0 on a dead week, so status carries the board by itself. Every term is scaled to [0,1] before weighting (§12 #8a). A war chest only ever attaches to a holder — the roster is holders, so notoriety cannot be bought without owning a Cabone.

eligibility.rule: on the board if THE OUTFIT >= 5 OR the wallet is active (listed, funded offer, or moved a token since season open)
eligibility.why: The site's groupByTier() already drops under-5. But a flat cut removes 9 of 11 listers, 1 of 2 war chests and 24 of 40 year-traders — the active wallets are the small ones. Activity is the second door in, so a one-token holder joins the moment they act.
eligibility.note: Rank is computed over ALL holders, so an excluded wallet still has a true rank — see the roster file. Gaps in the published board are expected.
